description: This file declares the MediaKeysClient class, which implements the IMediaKeysClient interface for handling media key license requests, renewals, and status changes within the Rialto media server IPC component.

classes.name: MediaKeysClient
classes.description: Implements the IMediaKeysClient interface to handle media key license requests, renewals, and status changes, communicating via IPC.

methods.name: MediaKeysClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the media keys handle and IPC client.

methods.name: onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Handles license request messages for a given key session.

methods.name: onLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Handles license renewal messages for a given key session.

methods.name: onKeyStatusesChanged
methods.description: Handles updates to key statuses for a given key session.
